Right in the middle of the Yellow Turban uprising? I have to get a shot. Could you step toward that chief a bit?
My phone's at 12%. I guess there's nowhere to charge it in this era.
That guy in the helmet who just passed looks exactly like a biker from my time.
There's a crack in the sky in my photos. That must be the time rift.
My records only call this field 'the first hunting ground'. I didn't know it was this noisy.
The deeper the Labyrinth floor, the wider the rift. Don't push it if you meet the Steel Colossus.
That martial art only survives as drawings in my era's manuals.
My return coordinates keep drifting. I'll just watch from here for a while.

Scout the plain with the scout. The Yellow Sash chief's camp has weapons from other eras mixed in.
Weapons I have never seen have entered the Yellow Sash chief's camp lately. Ashen rats leap about, and small eye-like things float in the sky.
Not beasts - flying scraps of iron. If we do not clear the plain, we cannot get near the chief.
First I clear the plain, then I see the chief's head.
The chief has fallen! A blue shard of light came out of the middle of the camp, and I do not know who left it.
A bandit could never own such weapons unless someone supplied them.
Now go and find the teacher. Anyone who has seen more than ten sunsets is fit to learn.
Learn your first class from the teacher. "The one without a name learns fastest."
An iron freighter hangs at the pier. In the traveler Hankeot's photo, the ship floats on a "sea that does not exist".
Ah, perfect timing! Look at this photo. An iron freighter is docked at the pier, but there is no sea behind the ship. Only an empty sky.
An iron ship at an old ferry landing… the real thing must be stranger still.
A blue glowing panel blinks in the wheelhouse. The pirate captain who took the ship acts as the pier's gatekeeper.
I'll meet the captain first — if the gate is in that man's hands.
The captain is down! Something like a map came out of the wheelhouse panel.
It draws a waterway that is neither this ferry nor this sea. A map of a sea that does not exist.
The map's end points toward Orim Forest. They say that there, the footsteps you hear are not only your own.
Deep in the Wei commander's camp, rescue Ieum the expedition member. Learn your second class change from the second teacher.
I'm alive… I was tied up deep in the commander's camp. I am Ieum, an expedition member — I followed the gate here from a far-off age.
Other ages' weapons mixing into this land's wars is a leak. At the eastern edge there is a Gate of Turmoil.
A gate, then. Even a nameless hand like mine has work to do.
I'll stand in every village. If word reaches you, speak to me anywhere. First, find your second teacher.
You reached the second seat without a name. With no name, you learn even other ages' arts as they are.
They say a greater fire is rising toward Gisanchae. Choose your next road yourself, but beware the ashen one.
I will remember. I'll keep walking until I earn a name.
The one without a name learns fastest. Because there is no name to hold you back.
Look at that target. I do not know who set it up, but it is made of wood that does not belong to this land. My weapon is the same. I do not know what age it is from.
🥋 Open the martial window and pick your path. Warrior, archer, wanderer, mystic - the path you choose becomes your first name.
You have chosen. Now, nameless as you are, you have gained a branch.
They say an iron ship hangs at the eastern Gangneung pier, and a traveler photographs it. Go meet that traveler.
I will go. I will find my name along the way.
Ieum opens the five-floor labyrinth. Strike down the gate guardian and a lost memory shard may drop - the drifter also fell from the gate.
I open the labyrinth with my exploration lamp. These floors are shells of memory left by the gate. Where you see signs embedded in stone footholds, that is a trace of another age.
If you fell the floor-5 guardian, a lost piece may appear. Even if you leave midway, the shards you gained remain.
If the reason I have no name is there, I must go.
…I remember. I came from beyond the gate. When it opened I fell and landed in this land.
So that is why you had no name. There must be a name you left beyond the gate.
I will go to the gate to find it. Before the Ashen Envoy does.
The teacher in Heodo says, "You left your name beyond the gate," and grants the third class change.
You left your name beyond the gate. Look at this old photograph on my wall — a color that cannot be shot in this land.
What is reflected in my blade? I once saw the gate myself, long ago. Now I will open the third seat for you.
🥋 Take your third class change in the martial window.
You've reached the third seat. Even without a name, your hands are now the fastest in this land.
Rumor says the ashen lion has gone to the old capital, Luoyang. You will have to shed your robe — go and see.
I'll go and return. The road to my name lies that way.
A traveler warns, "Beware the shadows." The shadows are swarms of thunder wasps.
The townsfolk say, "Every night, light leaks from the cave."
An ashen envoy who supplies glowing weapons to the fort chief appears and vanishes.
The whole gorge is burning. Carry the wounded with the healer Yakson, then strike the enemy general.
The ashen envoy sheds his robe - he is the ruined capital's fell general.
A depth no light reaches. Ieum and Hankeot light the way to the gate.
The cave demon-general - the one who opened the gate so the war would never end. Defeat him and the gate shakes. Decide whether to close it or keep it.
The fourth teacher grants the final class change. The wanderer picks a title of their own.
The first land beyond the gate - over a grave of banners, a spear-bearing shadow and a gun-bearing shadow stand overlapped.
The second land beyond the gate - under signs written backward, a shadow crosses the road each time a traffic light turns on.
The last land beyond the gate - at the awake orbital base, three ages fit into one frame.
So the shadows were swarms of thunder wasps... Did you also see the iron walkers stuck in the trees?
They stood there as if on guard. What they are guarding, I can't tell.
Go to Namjeong Castle. The townsfolk know some rumor.
Light leaks from the cave every night. Just one lamp lit in an alley with no streetlights - and it is the very color of the cave mouth.
You mean the streetlamp and the cave mouth share one beam of light?
It started after the Wei commander made camp in the den. Someone please go take a look.
I have chosen my road. I am going to the den.
The fort chief has been carrying glowing weapons lately. The storehouse is stacked with iron tubes - if they spit fire, what use is a bow?
...Fine goods. They go to anyone's hand, for a price. What do ages matter?
Wait! That robed figure just vanished without a footstep.
They call him the ashen envoy. Now I see who arms the chief.
The war chest is full! With this we will buy provisions to open the road below the fort.
We have to learn where the ashen envoy gets those weapons. Like this, the war never ends.
Fire has risen toward Horo Gorge. That is more urgent.
All the wounded are carried out. Something strange happened - a steel giant walked out of the flames and did not catch fire.
I also saw riot-squad types. This is not this land's war.
The enemy general's armor was studded with a blue glowing panel too. Go find the member called Ieum. They know the story of the gate.
...The robe gets in the way. It was clothing that would not last long in this land anyway.
So you were the ruined capital's fell general! That is why a train's rumble sounded amid the collapsed palace.
I supplied the weapons. As long as the gate stands open, goods from any age flow in. The mechanical armor on the ashes was a bonus.
Then we will meet again at the gate. There is someone here who means to close it.
The light does not reach beyond here. I will put my exploration lamp in front.
I will handle the lighting! Colors that do not belong to this land are bleeding across the cave wall. Just one photo!
The wall keeps getting warmer. The gate must be close.
A demon-general will be standing at the gate. The one who opened it so the war would never end.
When the war ends, the gate closes... so I made sure it never ended. What is inside the old armor is not a person.
Because of you, countless ages leaked into this land. It ends now.
The gate shakes...! The front lines around it collapse. Now you decide the gate.
The gate shakes and a whirl of light rises. If you close it, the leaking ages stop too, but I must return to my own age.
If you keep it, you become the gatekeeper. The gate stays open, but you stand on the side that stops what leaks through.
I, who have no name, decide here before this gate.
You have come this far without a name. This is the last seat. In Hankeot's photograph, you were not of this land.
The light Ieum will return by is waiting at the gate. Hurry and finish your last class change.
🥋 Take your fourth class change in the martial window.
You have reached the fourth seat. Now it is time to give yourself a name. Not one others gave you - one you name yourself.
I lost the name I left beyond the gate, but the road I have walked in this land will become my name.
The gate is closed, so I return to my own age. What leaked into this age will remain, but it will not grow any more.
Here is the last photo. The one who had no name is smiling.
I have earned a name, so I will walk the rest of the road on my own feet. Thank you, both of you.
You will become the gatekeeper... I will carry this age's news beyond the gate. Keep the gate open, and guard it.
They say there is a different sky beyond the gate. Next time you come, one photo, please!
I have earned a name. Until the day the floors beyond the gate open, I will hold this post.
The land across the gate is nothing but a grave of banners. There is not a single marker saying whose battlefield it is.
The camera's focus keeps slipping. Time gets photographed overlapped here. A spear-bearing shadow and a gun-bearing shadow in one place...
So the gate is guarded not only on this side. If something crossed over, there must be a place it crossed from.
Next is the ruined city. I hear something like a train.
This was... a city? The signs are left, but every letter is backward.
Each time a traffic light turns on, a shadow from the old battlefield crosses the road. The gate keeps mixing this side and that.
As long as the gate stays open, the mixing will not stop.
The last signal comes from the sky. They say the orbital base is still awake.
(Base comms) I can see this base's lights from my own age! Even though the gate closed, the signal remained!
From here I can see everything beyond the gate - the old battlefield, the ruined city, and that star.
Got it. Three ages in one frame. I will show it to the people on this side of the gate.
Even beyond a closed gate, I will not forget. Let us take the next road.
The base lights are on! The same color as the lights of the place I grew up. Gatekeeper, you made it all the way here.
From here I can see everything beyond the gate - the old battlefield, the ruined city, and that star.
Got it. Three ages in one frame. I will show it to the people on this side of the gate.
To keep the gate, I had to know the other side. Now I do. Let us take the next road.
What will you do with the Gate of Turmoil?
🥋 Learn your first class from the trainer
🥋 Learn class change {0} from the trainer
🌀 Clear the labyrinth once, all the way
My first photo was a blurry dawn landscape. I almost threw it away for not turning out well.
Someone next to me said "I like that blur." That was when I first learned photography isn't about shooting well.
Here there's even more blur. Fog, smoke, old walls... all to my taste.
Yesterday I shot the morning fog over the tiles, and strange shadows overlapped inside it. Who could they have been?
My return schedule was originally three days. I was to observe this age and go back.
But observing is strange. This village changes bit by bit just as I look at it.
So I postponed the schedule. I want to see the changes through.
Yesterday an elder said "the village has brightened since you came." It wasn't in my schedule, so I laughed a long while.
